heading: Cosmetic dentistry in McLean and Alexandria: questions.
items: Where can I see a cosmetic dentist in McLean or Alexandria?
Dr. Esam Nahlah, a board-certified prosthodontist, sees cosmetic patients at the Tysons Corner office in McLean and at 2855 Duke Street in Alexandria.
Can I see the result before treatment?
Yes. The smile evaluation includes a free Digital Smile Design showing what you would look like afterwards, before anything is prepared.
In what order are cosmetic treatments done?
The gumline first, because it decides how long a tooth looks; whitening next; porcelain last, matched to the shade your natural teeth end at.
Pricing, and the options at each price, are laid out at your smile evaluation, where the free preview is also made. Financing can spread the cost monthly.
Can cosmetic dentistry fix a bad bite?
No. A bad bite is functional, not cosmetic, and if that is what is wrong you will be told at the evaluation rather than have porcelain fitted over it.
